entities.name: Darhan Kaletaev
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Darhan Amanuly Kaletaev is a Kazakh politician who serves as the Kazakh Ambassador to Ukraine. Since October 12, 2020 to 30 March 2022, he was appointed Ambassador Extraordinary and Plenipotentiary of the Republic of Kazakhstan to the Republic of Moldova concurrently.
